sentence: 彼の判断は正しい。
sentence_meaning: His judgment is correct.
mnemonic: 刂 a blade telling two things apart, and 断 an axe taking one of them off for good. Both halves are somebody deciding, and neither of them is reversible: はんだん.
notes: 判断する is to judge or to decide. 決める きめる is picking; 判断 is the weighing that comes first.

sentence: 未来は誰にも分からない。
sentence_meaning: Nobody knows the future.
mnemonic: 未 a tree with the top branch not out yet, and 来 the crop that has not come in. Nothing here has happened, which is the entire point of it: みらい.
notes: 未 means not yet, and turns up in 未定 みてい, undecided. 将来 しょうらい is your own future rather than the world's.

sentence: 腹一杯食った。
sentence_meaning: I ate heartily.
mnemonic: The same 食 as 食べる, a lid over a heaped dish, except nobody here is being delicate about it. He eats standing up over the sink: くう.
notes: Blunt and masculine. 食べる たべる is the neutral one. 食う also does living on something: 芸で食う.

sentence: このケーキはあなたの分です。
sentence_meaning: This cake is your portion.
mnemonic: 八 splitting with 刀 a blade, so a portion cut off the whole. Your share of the bill, your share of the work, and the bun that comes with it: ぶん.
notes: The portion belonging to something. 自分 じぶん is your own share, which is where the word for self comes from.

sentence: そっちが私の部屋です。
sentence_meaning: That's my room over there.
mnemonic: そ- is your side of things again, and this is the offhand way of pointing at it. Not over there. Where you are, and nobody is reaching for こちら: そっち.
notes: The casual form of そちら. こっち, そっち, あっち, どっち run exactly as これ, それ, あれ, どれ do.

sentence: 彼はサッカーも野球もとても上手いです。
sentence_meaning: He's good at soccer and baseball.
mnemonic: 上 above the line and 手 a hand, so a hand above everybody else's. He makes it look like nothing at all, and you may as well not have tried: うまい.
notes: Also means tasty. 上手 じょうず is the same two characters read differently, and is the politer word for skilled.

sentence: 日時はご都合に合わせます。
sentence_meaning: The date can be scheduled according to your circumstances.
mnemonic: 𠆢 a lid coming down onto 口 a mouth, the same as 合う, except this time somebody is doing the fitting. Watches set to the same minute before anyone leaves: あわせる.
notes: 合う あう is things matching by themselves. 合わせる is you making them match.

sentence: これは母が大切にしていた指輪です。
sentence_meaning: This is a ring that meant a lot to my mother.
mnemonic: 大 big and 切 a blade, which reads wrong until you think of cutting a thing out in order to keep it. Tie it, set it aside, let nobody else near: たいせつ.
notes: 大事 だいじ is the near twin and either does most of the time. 大切にする is to treasure something.

sentence: 母は花が好きです。
sentence_meaning: My mother likes flowers.
mnemonic: 艹 grass on top, and underneath it something caught halfway through turning. One stem in a jar and the whole room is different: はな.
notes: Later comes 鼻 はな, nose, which sounds identical. 花見 はなみ is flower viewing.

sentence: 自分が悪い時は謝りましょう。
sentence_meaning: Be sure to apologize when you've done something wrong.
mnemonic: 言 speech with an arrow loosed beside it, the same 謝 as 感謝. Words sent out on purpose, except this time sending them costs you something: あやまる.
notes: Same 謝 as 感謝 かんしゃ. Both are words you have to actually put out there.

meaning: to snatch, to take by force
sentence: その男は彼女のバッグを奪ったぞ。
sentence_meaning: That man stole her bag.
mnemonic: The bird was in somebody else's hand a moment ago, and the big figure standing over it did not ask. It is his now: うばう.
notes: Taking by force. 取る とる is neutral, and 盗む ぬすむ is stealing quietly.

sentence: そのチームには勢いがありますね。
sentence_meaning: That team has momentum.
mnemonic: 力 power at the bottom and everything above it stacking up. Once it is moving nobody needs to push any more, and nobody could stop it either: いきおい.
notes: 勢いで means on a roll, carried by it. 力 ちから is strength standing still.

sentence: 動物の映画を見て、涙が出ました。
sentence_meaning: I saw a movie about animals and cried.
mnemonic: 氵 water with 戻 returning beside it, because it comes back whether you want it to or not. She got through the whole speech and then the last line went: なみだ.
notes: 涙が出る なみだがでる is the usual way of saying you are crying. 泣く なく is the act itself.

sentence: とても雰囲気のいいお店ですね。
sentence_meaning: The shop has a really good atmosphere.
mnemonic: 雨 rain split into 分 parts, 囲 a border drawn round it, and 気 the steam of the place. Three characters for a thing nobody can point at. It was fun, then it went icky: ふんいき.
notes: The feel of a place or a moment. 空気 くうき does the same job in 空気を読む, reading the room.

sentence: 嘘じゃありません。本当です。
sentence_meaning: It's not a lie. It's true.
mnemonic: 口 a mouth on the left with nothing whatsoever beside it. Sound coming out with no substance behind it, which is the whole definition: うそ.
notes: 嘘つき うそつき is a liar. 嘘! on its own is you are kidding.

sentence: 彼は私との結婚を望んでいます。
sentence_meaning: He hopes to marry me.
mnemonic: 月 the moon down in the corner, and the whole rest of the character is the distance to it. Wanting a thing you cannot reach from here, and no amount of zoom helps: のぞむ.
notes: 希望 きぼう is hope as a noun. 望む is the wanting itself.

sentence: 昨日のスピーチはとても緊張しました。
sentence_meaning: I was really nervous during my speech yesterday.
mnemonic: 糸 thread pulled until it will not give, and 張 a bow drawn 長 long. Two things at full stretch. Stood up to speak and your voice has gone elsewhere: きんちょう.
notes: 緊張する is to be nervous. Same 張 as 頑張る がんばる, where the stretch is effort rather than nerves.

sentence: 一緒に食事しよっか。
sentence_meaning: Do you want to eat together?
mnemonic: 一 one and 緒 a thread with a person on the end of it. Two of you tied into a single strand, going the same way whether or not it was agreed: いっしょ.
notes: 一緒に is together as an adverb. It also means the same: 一緒だ, they are identical.

sentence: 彼女は通りがかりの人に救われたよ。
sentence_meaning: She was saved by a passing stranger.
mnemonic: 求 seeking with 攵 a hand striking alongside, so going in and getting somebody out. Straight off the bank and scooped the dog up with one arm: すくう.
notes: 助ける たすける is helping, up to and including rescue. 救う is the rescue itself, and heavier.

sentence: 社長自らがその会社と交渉したよ。
sentence_meaning: The president himself negotiated with that company.
mnemonic: 自 the nose you point at to mean me, the same as in 自分. Except this one is an adverb: nobody asked him, nobody sent him, he went: みずから.
notes: Formal and written. 自分で じぶんで is the everyday by myself.

sentence: 地面に何か絵が描いてあるぞ。
sentence_meaning: There is some kind of picture drawn on the ground.
mnemonic: 土 earth on the left and 面 the face of a thing. Not the soil and not the planet. The flat top of it, which is what you land on: じめん.
notes: 地 reads ち on its own meaning ground, and じ in compounds like this one.

sentence: 一度の失敗であきらめてはいけないよ。
sentence_meaning: You must not give up after one blunder.
mnemonic: 失 a hand letting go without meaning to, and 敗 money with a hand striking at it. You lost hold and it cost something, and everybody saw: しっぱい.
notes: 失敗する is to fail or to make a mistake. 成功 せいこう is succeeding.

sentence: 彼女は昨日から私のことを避けているようなんだ。
sentence_meaning: She seems to have been avoiding me since yesterday.
mnemonic: 辶 the road again, except this one takes the long way on purpose. He saw them at the far end of the aisle and found something urgent in the other direction: さける.
notes: Avoiding a thing or a person. 逃げる にげる is running once it has already started.

sentence: 窓を開けてください。
sentence_meaning: Please open the window.
mnemonic: 穴 an opening cut into the wall with 心 a heart sat below it, which is about right. Nothing whatsoever to see out there, and you look anyway: まど.
notes: 窓口 まどぐち is a service counter, the window you queue at.

sentence: 彼女はとても素直で可愛いですね。
sentence_meaning: She is very honest and cute.
mnemonic: 素 undyed thread with nothing done to it, and 直 an eye looking dead ahead. No angle, no colour added. She says what she thinks and it costs her nothing: すなお.
notes: Not the same as 正直 しょうじき. 正直 is not lying; 素直 is not being difficult, and it is a compliment about temperament.

sentence: 肉が焼けました。
sentence_meaning: The meat is cooked.
mnemonic: A pictograph of a cut with the grain drawn through it. Nick a slice off the joint before it reaches the table and see what happens: にく.
notes: The same 肉 sits inside 月 when 月 carries the flesh sense, which is why 胸 and 腕 have it.

sentence: 冗談は止めてください。
sentence_meaning: Please stop joking.
mnemonic: 冗 somebody under a roof with nothing to do, and 談 talk warming up next to a double fire. Joe and Dan have been at it an hour and none of it was true: じょうだん.
notes: 冗談でしょ is you are joking. 嘘 うそ is a lie meant to deceive; a 冗談 is not.

sentence: 出発まで時間の余裕があります。
sentence_meaning: We have some time until departure.
mnemonic: 余 whatever did not get used, and 裕 clothing cut as wide as a valley. Room to move about inside it. He finished with an hour spare and never hurried: よゆう.
notes: Time, money or composure, all the same word. 余裕がある is having slack in the system.

sentence: 仕事が終わったら連絡します。
sentence_meaning: I'll contact you when I finish the job.
mnemonic: 連 carts strung out along a road, and 絡 thread tying one to the next. Not a conversation. The wire staying up between you: れんらく.
notes: 連絡する is to get in touch. 連絡先 れんらくさき is your contact details.

sentence: 彼は自分の人生を振り返ったわ。
sentence_meaning: He looked back on his life.
mnemonic: 人 a person and 生 the shoot pushing up. Not being alive, which is 命, and not daily living, which is 生活. The whole span, looked at from the far end: じんせい.
notes: 命 いのち is life itself, 生活 せいかつ is how it gets lived, 人生 is the course of one.

meaning: to emit, to set free, to shoot (e.g. an arrow or bullet)
sentence: 的に向けて矢を放った。
sentence_meaning: I shot the arrow at the target.
mnemonic: 方 a direction with 攵 a strike behind it. Point the thing and let go of it. An arrow, a bird, or the smell off something left in the sun: はなつ.
notes: 放す はなす is letting go, and 放送 ほうそう is broadcasting, the same idea aimed outward.

sentence: ラジオから美しい音楽が流れています。
sentence_meaning: Beautiful music is coming from the radio.
mnemonic: 氵 water, asking nobody's permission about anything at all. The tap and the Niagara are doing the same thing at different volumes: ながれる.
notes: Time, water, music and rumours all 流れる. 流す ながす is you making it flow.

sentence: あなたは私にとって特別な人です。
sentence_meaning: You're special to me.
mnemonic: 牛 the cow walked in through the temple gate, and 刂 the blade that cuts one thing out of the pile. Both halves single something out, so twice over it must be: とくべつ.
notes: Same 特 as 特に とくに and the same 別 as 別 べつ. Both are about picking one out of the rest.

sentence: あの連中は本当に面白い。
sentence_meaning: That bunch is really interesting.
mnemonic: 連 carts strung along a road again, and 中 the middle of them. That lot, taken as a single thing, and not admiringly: れんちゅう.
notes: Familiar or dismissive depending entirely on tone. Not a word for people you are being polite about.

sentence: 彼は両手を握り締めたの。
sentence_meaning: He clenched both his fists.
mnemonic: 両 two of a thing inside one frame, and 手 a hand. Both of them at once, because whatever it is will not go in one: りょうて.
notes: 両 means both: 両親 りょうしん is parents and 両方 りょうほう is both sides.

sentence: この町は人口が増えた。
sentence_meaning: The population has increased in this town.
mnemonic: 土 earth piled up, and then piled up again. Nobody added any of them on purpose. You open the drawer and there are eleven where there were four: ふえる.
notes: 増やす ふやす is you increasing it. 減る へる is the opposite.

meaning: to meet (by chance), to come across
sentence: アメリカで彼女と出会いました。
sentence_meaning: I met her in the United States.
mnemonic: 出 coming out and 会う meeting, welded together. Neither of you arranged any of it. You came round the corner and there they were, eight years later: であう.
notes: 会う あう is meeting, arranged or not. 出会う is specifically running into somebody.

sentence: 少年たちがサッカーをしている。
sentence_meaning: The boys are playing soccer.
mnemonic: 少 a small quantity of 年 years, which is all a boy is. The word turns up on the news and in manga titles and almost nowhere in speech: しょうねん.
notes: 少女 しょうじょ is the girl. Both are written words rather than what you would call a child to their face.

sentence: 彼女は同じ間違いを繰り返した。
sentence_meaning: She repeated the same mistake.
mnemonic: 糸 thread wound round and round, and 返す giving it back. Round it comes again, and you are about to say the same sentence for the third time: くりかえす.
notes: Same 返 as 返す かえす. 繰り返し くりかえし is a repetition as a noun.

sentence: 彼のわがままには我慢できません。
sentence_meaning: I can't put up with his selfishness.
mnemonic: 我 the self drawn as a hand holding a weapon, and 慢 a heart slowed right down. Keeping still when everything in you says do not. Gah. Man. がまん.
notes: 我慢する is to put up with it. Endurance rather than patience: something is wrong and you are not reacting to it.

sentence: 我々の決意は固いです。
sentence_meaning: Our decision is firm.
mnemonic: 我 the self, and 々 saying do that one again, so selves in the plural. Said from a podium by somebody speaking for everybody in the room: われわれ.
notes: 々 repeats the character before it, so this is 我我. Formal and a shade grand. 私たち わたしたち is the everyday we.

sentence: 冷えて指の感覚がない。
sentence_meaning: There's no sensation in my cold fingers.
mnemonic: 咸 all of it landing on 心 a heart, and 覚 the eye that took it in. Below thinking. What your hand knows about the water before you do: かんかく.
notes: 感じ かんじ is the impression; 感覚 is the faculty itself. Same 覚 as 覚える おぼえる.

sentence: このホールは音がよく響きます。
sentence_meaning: Sounds carry well in this hall.
mnemonic: 音 sound down at the bottom with a whole village piled on top of it to bounce off. One door in an empty building and the stairwell has an opinion: ひびく.
notes: Also does words landing: 心に響く こころにひびく is something that resonates.

sentence: 何とかお願いします。
sentence_meaning: Please, I'm begging you.
mnemonic: 何 the same what-on-earth as なに, with the answer left deliberately vague. It got done. Nobody is going to explain how, and it is better not to ask: なんとか.
notes: 何とかなる is it will work out somehow. As a request, 何とかして is do something about it.

sentence: 山の空気はきれいだ。
sentence_meaning: The mountain air is clean.
mnemonic: Three peaks and nothing else to it. Also a pile of anything at all: a 山 of washing, a 山 of work, and neither is going anywhere: やま.
notes: 富士山 ふじさん uses さん. 山 also means a heap, and 山場 やまば is the climax of something.

sentence: あなたの成績が下がったのは当たり前です。
sentence_meaning: No wonder your grades dropped.
mnemonic: 当 landing squarely on the spot and 前 whatever is right in front of you. So obvious it is not worth the sentence, and saying it out loud is nearly rude: あたりまえ.
notes: Same 当 as 当然 とうぜん, which is the more written version of the same idea.

sentence: 今日の予定を教えてください。
sentence_meaning: Please tell me what your schedule is for today.
mnemonic: 予 beforehand and 定 something settled under a roof. Fixed in advance, which is exactly as much as it promises. Written in pencil: よてい.
notes: 予定通り よていどおり is on schedule, using the 通り you already have. 約束 やくそく is a promise, which binds harder.

sentence: その試合は残念な結果になった。
sentence_meaning: The result of that game was disappointing.
mnemonic: 歹 bare bones with blades beside them, and 念 a heart stuck on 今 this moment. What is left over, and the feeling about it. The bus went as you reached the stop: ざんねん.
notes: 残念ながら opens bad news, meaning unfortunately. It is disappointment rather than apology.

sentence: 警官は怪しい男の後を追ったよ。
sentence_meaning: The police officer went after the suspicious man.
mnemonic: 辶 the road with somebody already well up it and you coming along behind. Not catching them. The state of being behind and still going: おう.
notes: Same reading as 王 おう, king. 追いかける おいかける is the more active chasing.

sentence: ハインさんは綺麗な人です。
sentence_meaning: Hein-san is a beautiful person.
mnemonic: 糸 finely woven thread, and 麗 a deer with its antlers drawn out matching. Neat is the point, which is why it does clean as readily as it does lovely: きれい.
notes: Almost always written in kana. 美しい うつくしい is beauty only; きれい covers tidy as well.
